line.comment: * Mordan8 - pre-determine at creation time if this ship will bail when attacked. Only applicable for M6 and larger.
* Moved class checking here.
* Note: The game defines Big Ship as M6, M8, TM, M1, M2, M7, TL.
* Mordan2, if this is an attack vessel and not a transport, default the turrets to attack all enemies.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Full equip cheat is deprecated; all ships come with shields and lasers, except Spitfyre which doesn't come with lasers.
* Expanded 2.2: AP Gunner no longer comes with lasers.
* Mordan2 (Add-Ons 1.8: updated comments)
* if M1, M2, M7, or TL, install good scanner.
* Note 1: TMs and M8s automatically come with Triplex scanners.
* if TM, install a Transporter Device. Useful for fleet supplier role. Note, Carriers automatically come with Transporter devices and Carrier Repair Modules (see TShips)
* A few TMs come with them.. seems random. So we're adding one just to be sure.
* end Mordan2
* Add-Ons 2.0: Use ship class instead of race.
* Attack enemies
* Defend ship
* We add missiles and CCDS in Mayhem.Task.TemplateWhenReady -> Mayhem.EquipShip.Missiles.
* Zero Hour 2.0 - AI also gets free lasers and shields
* Mordan2. Add the Triplex only for huge ships.
* Add-Ons 1.3: black market ships do not spawn with internal defenses. Doubled chances of capital ships getting defenses on insane.
* Add-Ons 2.0: Cleaned up. Commonwealth ships (not TER) might spawn with HPD. M6 and TM now have a chance to spawn with AFS or HPD.
* Guaranteed defenses.
* Xenon do not get ISL because their defense calculation does not factor ISL into account (their defenses are already equivalent to a full ship of 85-fighting marines).
* Guaranteed AFS for corporations.
* OCV are hack-resistant, not hack-immune. 50% chance for capitals, 25% chance otherwise.
* Random commonwealth defenses.
* Normal chance, using M6/TM as normal. Capital ships double the chance, and insane difficulty doubles it again.
* Terran ships cannot have HPD.
* M6/TM:
* - AFS: 6.25% normal, 12.5% insane
* - HPD: 5% normal, 10% insane
* Capital Ships:
* - AFS: 12.5% normal, 25% insane
* - HPD: 10% normal, 20% insane
* - ISL: 33.3% normal, 66.7% insane
* Add-Ons 1.4: On insane difficulty, 50% of freighters have firewall software. This reduces the number of hackable TS/TP that the player can get.
* Mordan7 Change Default Missile Fire Probability from 5% to 75%.
* Add-Ons 2.0.2: Moved the fix to here since 75% was being overridden by default 50%. This 75% makes missile ships use their missiles a lot faster, but it's still better than the default 50%.
* Unlocks the trade report menu.
* Default job names.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Now calls helper script.
